description: This file implements the CommandConsumerFactory interface for creating and managing command consumers in an AMQP messaging network. It handles creating tenant-scoped and device-specific command consumers, manages liveness checks for consumers, maps device IDs to gateways, and provides command response senders. It uses caching, and supports reconnect logic and distributed command handling in a messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: CommandConsumerFactoryImpl
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing command consumers and response senders, with integrated liveness checking and mapping mechanisms.

classes.name: LivenessCheckData
classes.description: Holds information for liveness checks, including timer ID and command handlers supplier.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the messaging network and gateway mapper.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the messaging network and gateway mapper.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a command consumer for a specific device, optional gateway, with handlers and optional liveness check interval.

methods.name: getCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Provides a new command response sender link for a given tenant and reply ID.
